title: Right / left 11-11 (k-means)
summary: 48-minute recording with ~10 right and ~9 left arm movements among natural ones (writing, scratching, stretching), plus a video. Events are detected automatically and grouped with k-means; times from the video and R/L from Andrew's notes are used only to evaluate.
result: 15/19 R/L correct with k = 2 (ARI 0.30); all 23 annotated movements detected, 2 extra events
method: k-means (k = 2) on one feature card per detected event, yaw drift removed, angles relative to the 3 s before each event
